body.label: Target
body.html: One creature within weapon range and line of sight.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one creature within weapon range. On a success, deal 1 weapon damage.

surges.html: Ignore 1 Defense against the primary target for this Action.
On a success, the target cannot make Reactions against your next Ballistics Action this turn.

rider.title: EXECUTION
rider.html: If the target is Locked by you, you may end that Lock after rolling. If you do and this Action succeeds, deal +1 weapon damage and ignore 1 Defense.
